title: Claydy Wedding Environment Variables
description: All VITE_* variables are exposed to the browser. Never add secrets here without the VITE_ prefix unless they are build-only in vite.config.js.

VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Supabase publishable (recommended) or legacy anon key. Safe for the browser.

VITE_SITE_URL.description: Public site URL without trailing slash. Required for WhatsApp/iMessage link preview images.

VITE_COUPLE_NAMES.description: Fallback couple names for share previews when Supabase has not loaded yet.

VITE_WEDDING_DATE.description: Fallback wedding date for share previews when Supabase has not loaded yet.
